location: Game Setup step 6; Draft Phase; Build Phase and its end; two-player road update; Solo Mode; credits
firstPlayerRule: Whoever has lived in the same place the longest drafts first.
clarifications: Give that person the First Player Card. Players draft one villager at a time in clockwise order.
Drafting comes before building. In the Build Phase, each player finishes their building actions before the next player acts.
At the end of the Build Phase, pass the First Player Card to the player on the left.
Solo mode uses the Countess: after drafting a card for yourself, assign a face-up Road villager to her Village before replenishing the Road.

The text extractor repeats that instruction on page 5, but it is not visually printed there. The two-player reverse-order coin placement on page 11 occurs after drafting and does not select the opening player. No address or new interpretation of same place is requested.

location: Setup closing instruction; Rules and Turn Sequence; Solo Mode setup and rules; back-cover credits
firstPlayerRule: The player with the most “hipster cred” goes first.
clarifications: Turns proceed clockwise from that player.
Solo mode uses a different sequence: build and score for yourself, then build and score for the Grifter, then draw your replacement Building.
interpretation: The rulebook does not define a measure for “hipster cred”; the group must agree how to apply it.
evidenceNotes: The publisher's retail product links this 24-page base manual, whose back cover states ©2021. The subjective starter criterion is reproduced without inventing a metric or a tie-break. location: Setup step 7; Production Phase; Construction Phase and Passing Hands; end of Construction; Solo Mode; credits
firstPlayerRule: The player with the loudest voice takes the first Construction turn.
clarifications: First, all players complete the Production Phase. Give the loudest-voiced player the First Expedition Card; that holder starts Construction, followed by clockwise turns.
With three to five players, pass hands left after everyone has taken a turn. The new First Expedition Card holder starts the next round of turns.
With two players, the starter stays the same throughout that Construction Phase. The other player starts in the next Era.
Solo mode omits the First Expedition Card. You take your action before adding and resolving a Solo Card for GURPS.
